name: Alert
summary: An inline, contextual feedback banner — info, success, warning, error, or branding — in regular/small sizes, with an optional full-width banner mode and a trailing action.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-alert> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; tone is the `type` attribute (info · success · warning · error · branding), the status glyph is summoned BY NAME from the shared icon library. `size` compacts it (regular · small), `banner` makes it a full-width, square-cornered page notice, `hide-icon` drops the glyph, a slot="action" carries a trailing button/link, and `closable` adds a dismiss control that animates the banner out on a persistent node and emits a composed `close`.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper for the composed `close` event; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: flex row, gap 10 · padding 10 14 · radius 8 · 1px tonal border

spec.label: Banner
spec.value: full-width, square (radius 0), border on the bottom edge only

spec.label: Icon
spec.value: status glyph via <aha-icon> (system-info / system-check-circle / system-warning-circle / system-x-circle / system-sparkle)

props.name: heading
props.desc: Optional bold title above the message

props.name: hide-icon
props.desc: Suppresses the leading status icon (the showIcon toggle)

props.name: slot="action"
props.desc: Trailing action — a button or link

props.name: close
props.desc: Composed event when the banner is dismissed

whenToUse.when: a persistent, inline message tied to a region of the page (a form warning, a page-level notice)
a brief, transient confirmation of an action that then disappears
a richer, stacking message with a title + description, often from a background event

opinion.note: Keep the message to one or two lines; lead with what happened, then what to do. Reserve error for real failures — over-using red trains people to ignore it.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Figma sets (Alert + Alert-banner, fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy): five types (info · success · warning · error · branding), regular + small sizes, an optional heading + description, a showIcon toggle (hide-icon), a closable ✕, a trailing action slot, and a full-width square banner mode (the separate Alert-banner set). Tones bound to the DS V3 semantic families — bg-informative/positive/warning/negative + matching border/text tokens; branding on bg-accent + border-focus + color-primary. Radius on the scale (radius-default = 8). The status glyph is a real DS icon summoned by name, never an inline SVG.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Probe is the default (info) alert; the branding-type alert in the same preview is measured to assert the new tone.
